title: Bloodline
description: After freeing Serana from Dimhollow Crypt, escort her to Castle Volkihar and meet her father Lord Harkon, who offers the gift of vampirism. Choose to accept and join the Volkihar court or refuse and be banished back to the Dawnguard.

base_facts: I was locked away in Dimhollow Crypt for centuries.
My father is Lord Harkon, ruler of the Volkihar vampires.
I carry an Elder Scroll but I cannot discuss why.
I do not get along with my father.

ESCORT_SERANA: I have been freed from my sarcophagus and need to get home to Castle Volkihar.
MEET_HARKON: I have returned to Castle Volkihar with the stranger who freed me.
HARKON_OFFERS_GIFT: My father has offered the stranger his blood as a reward.
ACCEPT_GIFT: The stranger accepted my father's gift and joined our court.
REFUSE_GIFT: The stranger refused my father's gift and was banished from the castle.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The stranger who freed me has either become a Vampire Lord of my father's court or been banished to rejoin Isran and the Dawnguard.
I remain at Castle Volkihar regardless of the stranger's choice about my father's gift.
Whether the stranger joined us or now opposes us, I am grateful they freed me from Dimhollow.

base_facts: I am Lord Harkon, ruler of the Volkihar vampire court.
I am among the oldest and most powerful vampires in Skyrim.
My daughter Serana was lost to me for centuries.

MEET_HARKON: My daughter Serana has been returned to me at last.
HARKON_OFFERS_GIFT: I have offered the stranger the gift of my blood in gratitude for returning Serana.
ACCEPT_GIFT: The stranger accepted my gift and joins my court as a Vampire Lord.
REFUSE_GIFT: The stranger refused my gift and is banished from my castle forever.
QUEST_COMPLETE: If the stranger accepted my gift, they are now a Vampire Lord of my court and have earned my favor; The Bloodstone Chalice awaits to test their worth.
If the stranger refused my gift, they are banished from my castle forever and have returned to Isran and the Dawnguard as my enemy.
The stranger's choice leaves them either standing with my court or against it; there is no middle ground.

beats.comment: Player freed Serana and must escort her to Castle Volkihar.
Player arrived at Castle Volkihar and must speak to Lord Harkon.
Harkon offers the gift of vampirism. Player must choose to accept or refuse.
Player accepts Harkon's blood and becomes a Vampire Lord, joining the Volkihar court.
Player refuses Harkon's gift and is banished from Castle Volkihar, returning to the Dawnguard.
Quest completes either by joining Volkihar (stage 180) or returning to Dawnguard (stage 190).
